body: @sepo-agent /answer what are some easy ways to stop all action workflows? or we should add a flag?

comments.body:
Short answer: for today, use GitHub’s native workflow disable. For Sepo itself, yes, I think we should add a first-class repo variable flag.

Easy options now:

1. Stop **all repo workflows**:
```bash
gh workflow list --repo self-evolving/repo --all --json id --jq '.[].id' |
  xargs -n1 gh workflow disable --repo self-evolving/repo
```

2. Stop only **Sepo-owned workflows**:
```bash
gh workflow list --repo self-evolving/repo --all --json id,path \
  --jq '.[] | select(.path | startswith(".github/workflows/agent-")) | .id' |
  xargs -n1 gh workflow disable --repo self-evolving/repo
```

3. Stop only **scheduled Sepo work**:
Set `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` to:
```json
{"default_mode":"disabled"}
```
That matches the existing schedule policy shape, but it only affects `schedule` events; manual `workflow_dispatch` still works. See [`AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/memory.md#L124-L145).

4. Stop only **multi-step follow-up automation**:
`AGENT_AUTOMATION_MODE` is not a global stop switch. It controls orchestrator handoff behavior, not mention/label/manual workflow starts. The current entrypoints still call the router from mention and label workflows via [`agent-entrypoint.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-entrypoint.yml#L46-L57) and [`agent-label.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-label.yml#L30-L40).

I’d add a flag. Proposed shape:

```text
AGENT_ENABLED=false
```

Default behavior: enabled unless explicitly set to `false`.

Implementation plan:

1. Add a cheap job-level guard to Sepo entry/manual/scheduled workflows before checkout/runtime setup.
2. Apply it to `agent-entrypoint.yml`, `agent-label.yml`, approval, orchestrator, implement, review, fix-pr, self-approve, self-merge, memory, rubrics, update, project-manager, cleanup/stale workflows.
3. Keep `test-scripts.yml` outside the flag because it is normal CI, not Sepo automation.
4. Document `AGENT_ENABLED` in the configuration list near the existing global variables.
5. Add an envelope/workflow test that every `agent-*.yml` workflow has the pause guard.

Recommended semantics: when `AGENT_ENABLED=false`, Sepo workflows skip quietly and do not spend provider/runtime setup. For emergency shutdown beyond Sepo, still use GitHub’s native Actions disable.
